Plot Bootstrap Threshold Distributions

Source: R/validate_cutpoint_methods.R
plot.validate_cutpoint_result.Rd

Generates a density plot map visualizing the empirical sampling distributions of optimal cut-points derived from bootstrap runs.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'validate_cutpoint_result'
plot(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A validate_cutpoint_result object.

...

Additional arguments passed down to downstream rendering pipelines.

Value

A ggplot2 graphics canvas object.

srrstats compliance

.
